status: ADDENDUM after delegated adversarial court audit and my own re-verification
summary: The MECHANISM holds (all eight attacked areas pass by my own direct construction). But the FOCUSED COURT is weaker evidence than the test count suggests: four of the fifteen commissioned cases have material caveats, and two load-bearing properties are proven by STATIC analysis or SELF-REFERENCE rather than runtime behaviour.

gaps.finding: the ONLY assertion is `with pytest.raises(...): ApplicabilityAuthorityRecord(SOURCES[0], 'SOURCE_NOT_APPLICABLE_TO_THIS_SERVICE_AND_USE')`. It tests the CONSTRUCTOR error path (a negative without basis) and never resolves a valid negative, never asserts the public state NOT_APPLICABLE.
gaps.corroboration: grep over the whole court file shows NOT_APPLICABLE appears ONLY in `!=`/`not in` comparisons (lines 106, 114, 122, 139) and in the PUBLIC_STATES set literal (line 368). It is never positively asserted as an observed state.
gaps.title_not_met: the case title promises exact negative applicability; behaviourally it proves only the missing-basis refusal
gaps.impact: coverage gap only. I exercised the positive-negative path myself and the mechanism is correct (a bound negative renders NOT_APPLICABLE). But the COURT does not pin it.

gaps.case: multiple applicable, preserving an UNRANKED set
gaps.finding: the CARDINALITY half is genuine behaviour (`len(admissible)==2`). The UNRANKED half is asserted against self-declared booleans that as_dict() unconditionally sets True (module ~L640-643) and against the module's own ORDERING_SEMANTICS constant. Asserting a module's self-description is not independent evidence that the module is unranked.
gaps.impact: my OWN independent proof stands and is stronger: 1 distinct replay identity across all 6 candidate-order and all 6 authority-record permutations, plus a value-inspecting enumeration showing no rank/score/priority/preference/weight VALUE field exists. The COURT is weaker than my evidence, not the mechanism.

gaps.finding_a: the case is parametrised over `list(M.FORBIDDEN_AUTHORIZED_PURPOSES)` - the very tuple the production function checks. It is SELF-REFERENTIAL: if the production tuple were truncated, the court would simply collect fewer cases and still pass. The court cannot detect a narrowing of the prohibition list.
gaps.finding_b: assert_receipt_does_not_authorize(receipt, purpose) NEVER READS ITS `receipt` ARGUMENT. Verified by reading the full body: it validates `purpose`, then raises if the purpose is in the forbidden tuple. The receipt is never inspected.
gaps.consequence: the court proves only that the FUNCTION refuses the purposes it is written to refuse. It does NOT prove the receipt fails to carry authority - which is the property the case title claims.
gaps.impact: the non-authorization property is instead carried STRUCTURALLY by DECISION_MATRIX (every may_* flag False for every decision), which I verified by value inspection. So the mechanism is sound; the tested proposition is narrower than claimed.

gaps.finding: the runtime half re-runs IDENTICAL inputs twice and compares replay_identity - tautological, since no evidence field is ever varied. The substantive check is a static AST source-text scan (L424-427) for forbidden field reads.
gaps.note: I earlier praised this AST scan as a genuine STRUCTURAL proof. That stands - it is a real static guarantee that the resolver reads no forbidden field attribute. But it is STATIC analysis, not runtime behaviour, and the 'runtime' half proves nothing.

what_is_unaffected: the purely constant/vocabulary tests (PUBLIC_STATES, DECISION_PRECEDENCE, DECISION_MATRIX flag guards) live among the OTHER 32 test functions, NOT among the 15 commissioned cases. So no commissioned case is purely constant - the correct criticism is narrower than 'constant tests'.

arithmetic_correction.derivation: 47 test functions total in the court file. 15 distinct functions are the commissioned cases, one of which is parametrised x14. So additional FUNCTIONS = 47 - 15 = 32, and additional COLLECTED tests = 60 - 28 = 32. Not 45.
arithmetic_correction.verified: my own collect run reported 60; the parametrised case contributes 14 of them (28 = 14 from the parametrised power case + 14 other commissioned cases)
arithmetic_correction.impact: a bookkeeping error in a receipt field. It does not affect the pass/fail result or any mechanism conclusion, but it should be corrected in the artifact.

net_effect_on_disposition: NONE. The discovery path is my own direct construction against the module, independent of the court. The court gaps are court-quality issues with BOUNDED repairable fixes, not mechanism defects.

regression_verified_by_me.my_before: proxy (court ignored), not the parent checkout
